În Dropbox App Console: creează o aplica: In the Dropbox App Console: create an app with Scoped access and the App folder type. Under Permissions tick account_info.read, files.metadata.read, files.content.read and files.content.write, and under Redirect URIs add exactly http://127.0.0.1:53682/. Paste the App key (the secret is not needed).
În Microsoft Entra (App registrations):: In Microsoft Entra (App registrations): register an app for personal Microsoft accounts, under Authentication add the Mobile and desktop platform with the redirect URI http://localhost and allow public client flows. Under API permissions add Files.ReadWrite.AppFolder and User.Read. Paste the Application (client) ID.
În Box Developer Console: creează o apli: In the Box Developer Console: create a Custom App with OAuth 2.0 authentication (User Authentication). Under Configuration tick the scope Read and write all files and folders and add the redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:53683/. Paste the Client ID and Client Secret.
